extra.value: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) disclosed that it sold 1,690 BTC between August 3–9 at an average price of $64,262, generating $108.6 million. The proceeds were used entirely to fund buybacks of STRC preferred stock, which has been trading below its $100 par value. Context: Strategy has now sold 6,948 BTC year-to-date under its 'Digital Credit Capital Framework' — a plan adopted in late June that authorizes limited Bitcoin sales to fund preferred dividends, buybacks, and cash reserves when issuing equity looks less attractive. This represents a fundamental paradigm shift: Strategy, long viewed as the world's most committed institutional Bitcoin holder (peak holdings: ~400,000+ BTC), is now a systematic Bitcoin seller. The market reaction was rapid: the 13:00-15:00 UTC breakdown candles (197 BTC and 199 BTC respectively) coincide with the time US markets processed the morning disclosure. BTC fell from ~$65,200 (12:00 UTC) to ~$64,290 (15:00 UTC close) on the news.
